item.title: CFP: Things That Go Bump in the North: Canadian Horror Media
item.description: Horror stories speak of our fears. In doing so, horror stories also speak of our everyday, our “normal,” as this ordinariness is quickly thrown into disarray. Things That Go Bump in the North will look at Canadian horror across media – from fiction, film, and television to games, graphic novels, and web series. item.title: IJR Volume 8 is available to download!
item.description: Our journal is available online - full text and open access. IJR Volume 8 explores issues of access and justice. Read ten original research articles by scholars from a range of disciplines that take up these issues in new and innovative applications. Read more and explore past issue of the IJR in our online open access archive.
